jobs.title: Senior Biospecimen Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

LabConnect improves lives by partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies, and clinical research organizations (CROs) to accelerate the development of new medicines around the world.

We are an independent, global, one-stop-shop focused on delivering Central Laboratory Services that are tailor-made, timely and flexible to meet the evolving study demands of traditional to increasingly complex trials. Additionally, we provide Functional Service Provider (FSP) Solutions, supporting our clients with scientific and technical expertise, acting as an extension of their team, coordinating all laboratory related needs, advising on strategies for lab data collection and providing end-to-end analytical and logistical solutions.

The Senior Biospecimen Project Manager will be the centralized point of contact to drive biospecimen lifecycle management and resulting analytical data from clinical studies.

Please note: This is a remote role is open to candidates based in the United States. Candidates located in California are eligible only if they reside outside of the San Francisco Bay Area (defined as locations more than 100 miles from the Bay Area).

Responsibilities:

Drive biospecimen lifecycle management from sample receipt to analysis and final disposition
Ensure accurate specimen metadata
Communicate study specimen updates to client groups and stakeholders
Increase the efficiency of specimen management through sharing of knowledge and best practices
Provide site support and drive query resolution
Participate or lead special projects as assigned
Adhere to client policies and Standard Operating Procedures
Review clinical study protocols and service providers’ scope of work documents for sample handling and processing details
Set up and maintain a complex study sample tracker – experience in manual sample tracking for complex clinical studies
Create and manage project plans
Manage data transfer plans with analytical laboratories
Manage data received from external and internal laboratories, including data generated in exploratory studies
Manage specimen metadata discrepancies and ensure resolution
Submit specimens for analytical assays per study timelines
Review status of specimens collected and completeness of data
Contribute to meeting database locks by ensuring all specimens have a final result and data transfer is complete; create reports for data management as needed
Provide guidance to others and act as technical resource within the department
Lead projections for annual and long-term planning to clinical team
Provide oversight and management to junior personnel

Skills/Abilities:

Understanding of transaction-based inventory and data management systems as well as clinical trial processes
Understanding of ICH, GCP, GLP, and local regulations
LabMatrix experience preferred
Strong excel experience required, extensive macro and template building knowledge desired
Strong computer literacy, including Word, SharePoint, Smartsheet and PowerPointAdvanced planning, organizational, time management skills

Experience / Education:

B.A./B.S. in life sciences, medical technology, or related field and 5-7 years of directly related experience.
Experience in life sciences or medically related fields, including clinical development, biospecimen lifecycle management, or clinical laboratory analysis.
Project Management experience is also preferred.
Very high attention to detail and excellent multi-tasking skills is required for success in this position.

Join our team and discover how your work can impact patients' lives
around the world!

Some of the Perks our LabConnectors Love:

Financial Security (Base Pay, 401k Match and Possible Annual Bonus Eligibility)
Health Benefits beginning on date of hire
PTO plan, plus 11 Paid Company Holidays, and 1 Day to Volunteer in your community
Short and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, and AD&D
We celebrate our differences, which enriches our culture!

In addition to great perks and challenging work assignments, we invest in our people with career growth opportunities, globally. We believe in a friendly and collaborative environment with open lines of communication. While living out our values of People First, Quality Focused, Customer Centered, Technology Driven,
and Accountability Always
.

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and value the diversity of our workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. To learn more about equal employment opportunity, please view the posters here: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters

LabConnect also prioritizes the privacy and security of your personal data. All candidate information is handled in accordance with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). To learn more, please review our Privacy Notice on our website, by navigating to https://www.labconnect.com/

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Green Building Certifications
jobs.description:
Reports to: Associate Director, Certifications
Location: Pacific NW preferred (Hybrid: PDX Metro Area, Remote: Outside of PDX Metro Area)
Classification: Full-time, Exempt
Job Ladder Classification: Manager
Job Close Date: Applications received by 9/14/2026 will be prioritized. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

Who we’re looking for

You are an experienced project manager who is comfortable supporting complex new multifamily development projects. You possess sound technical judgment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to guide multidisciplinary teams toward successful project outcomes. You are motivated to support the regional housing industry, and are comfortable working with affordable housing organizations, developers, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, public agencies, and internal technical specialists. 

You have a strong foundation in multifamily construction and building science, an ability to learn technical standards, and the judgment to know when to independently resolve an issue and when to engage additional technical expertise. You do not need to be an expert in each green building certification program on day one. However, you will be able to translate complex certification and technical requirements into clear priorities, decisions, and next steps for project teams. 

This position is primarily a project management role focused on the successful delivery of multifamily green building certification projects, including technical review, certification coordination, client support, and internal process management. You will work closely with our field verification and energy modeling staff to deliver successful project outcomes. While this position is not primarily responsible for field verification or energy modeling, opportunities to contribute technical expertise may arise based on organizational needs and individual experience.

You may have opportunities to represent Earth Advantage as a technical subject matter expert in client education events, workforce trainings, conference presentations, workshops, research initiatives, and other industry engagement activities throughout the PNW.

What you’ll be doing

Project Management: 

Serve as the primary project manager and client contact for assigned multifamily certification projects from design through final certification.
Manage a portfolio of multifamily projects pursuing Earth Advantage Multifamily, LEED for Homes, and/or other recognized green building and energy certifications.
Develop and manage project schedules, certification milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and deadlines. Ensure all project communications, documentation, and deliverables are complete, accurate, clear and professionally presented. 
Coordinate certification services associated with affordable housing funding, incentive, financing, tax credit, or verifier requirements when included within the project scope.
Maintain accurate project information within Earth Advantage's customer relationship management, project management, and file management systems.

Technical Review & Certification: 

Review construction drawings, specifications, product data, cut sheets, approved submittals, and other project documentation for certification compliance.  
Understand the interaction between certification requirements, project design decisions, construction practices, and building performance.
Coordinate with Earth Advantage field verification staff to ensure required inspections, testing, checklists, and supporting documentation are completed at appropriate project milestones.
Collaborate with energy modeling staff to coordinate project information, assumptions, design changes, documentation, and modeling deliverables.

Client Support & Industry Engagement: 

Support affordable housing organizations and project teams in navigating certification requirements associated with high-performance and sustainable housing goals.
Build productive, long-term relationships with developers, affordable housing organizations, architects, engineers, contractors, and other project partners.
Explain complex technical and certification requirements in ways that are understandable and actionable for different audiences.
Participate in relevant client meetings, conferences, industry events, and occasional project site visits.  

Internal Operations: 

Support the successful delivery and continuous improvement of Earth Advantage's multifamily certification programs by strengthening operational processes, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
Assist in developing, documenting, and improving certification workflows, project management procedures, templates, and internal tools. 
Identify recurring process challenges and recommend practical improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency, quality, and client experience. 
Contribute to organizational knowledge by documenting technical interpretations, lessons learned, and effective practices.

Required qualifications

Demonstrated commitment to Earth Advantage's mission and values. 
Five or more years of relevant professional experience in multifamily construction, architecture, engineering, construction management, sustainability, building performance, affordable housing, or a related field, including significant responsibility for managing projects, clients, schedules, or multidisciplinary teams. 
Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple complex projects, competing priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines. 
Strong working knowledge of multifamily construction and building science, including the ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, submittals, and other technical documentation. 
Strong analytical judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to research technical questions, evaluate information, and determine appropriate next steps. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary technical teams. 
Ability and willingness to learn new technical standards, certification requirements, and workflows and to travel periodically throughout the Pacific Northwest.

Preferred qualifications

Seven or more years of experience managing multifamily construction, design, sustainability consulting, building performance, affordable housing, or similarly complex projects. 
Experience working with affordable housing developers, owners, funders, or project teams. 
Experience supporting projects that successfully achieved green building, energy, or high-performance building certifications. 
Experience with one or more programs such as Earth Advantage Multifamily, LEED for Homes, ENERGY STAR Multifamily New Construction, Enterprise Green Communities, PHIUS/Passive House, or comparable programs. 
Relevant professional credentials such as LEED Green Associate or LEED AP, RESNET HERS Rater or applicable multifamily credential, BPI Multifamily, PHIUS Certified Verifier, or similar. 
Experience collaborating with energy modeling professionals and an understanding of whole-building energy modeling workflows (e.g., IESVE or equivalent) and how modeling informs design decisions, code compliance, and green building certifications.
Experience reviewing construction documents for certification, sustainability, quality assurance, code, or similar compliance requirements. 
Familiarity with project management and document-review platforms such as Monday.com, Bluebeam, Microsoft 365, or comparable tools. 
Experience working with funding, incentive, tax credit, financing, or verification requirements associated with affordable or high-performance housing. 
Interest or experience sharing technical knowledge through client education, workshops, presentations, contractor training, research initiatives, or other subject matter expert activities.

Compensation

$78,000 - $103,000 annual compensation. 
Note: This range represents the compensation opportunity within this specific Earth Advantage job class. Compensation for new hires generally falls in the low to mid point of the pay range. 

Benefits

Earth Advantage offers an excellent benefit package including: 
5 weeks PTO + 8 paid holidays
80% employer paid medical and dental premiums
Deductible reimbursement program through our HRA
FSA for medical, transit, parking, and dependent care
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
401k plan with match
Life insurance, short term and long-term disability insurance 
Fully paid family leave
6 week sabbatical opportunity after 5 years

To apply

Applications received by 09/14/2026 will be prioritized. Finalists must have eligibility to work in the US as Earth Advantage is not able to provide VISA sponsorship or have remote work outside of the US. 
Please submit the following materials to apply for this position (PDF or Word format):
Resume
Cover letter (optional) 
Three professional references ( can provide on request)

Apply directly at our website OR 
Email applications materials to: jobs@earthadvantage.org
Subject line: “Sr. Project Manager, Green Building Certifications ” - Last name, First name"

AI and the Hiring Process at Earth Advantage:

Earth Advantage values human judgment and does not use Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any part of the recruiting or hiring process. Each application submitted is screened and reviewed by our team to create a more personal candidate experience and to reduce ethical and bias concerns that may come with using AI.  

While we may not use AI in our process, we understand that AI is becoming part of daily life and some candidates may use AI responsibly as a support in preparing application materials and interviews. However, we value authenticity, accuracy, and truthfulness. Application responses and interview answers should reflect your own knowledge, skills, and experiences. While AI can supplement preparation, it cannot replace the originality and judgment we look for in our employees. This ensures fairness, transparency, and equity for all applicants in the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel, which enable our customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions.

We are looking for you,

Project Manager

to join our Investment Project Management team located in Porvoo.

As a Project Manager you will be leading and managing the project team, scope, resources, time, cost and change management. Strong networking and communication skills are necessary to ensure efficient communication and information sharing between internal and external project stakeholders.

Reasons to join

We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate.

We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment.

Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging.

In addition, our benefits
for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, good occupational health care, a membership in a sickness or health insurance fund and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure time activities, e.g. by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi).

The job is located in Kilpilahti, Porvoo, which is about 30 minutes by car from the center of Helsinki. We organize free bus transportation to Kilpilahti for our employees from the capital region, Porvoo and the nearby areas.

More about the job

Your role in our team

Project Manager is accountable for overall delivery of assigned projects including following:

Manage the projects according to Neste operating model safely in compliance with agreed project scope, schedule, cost and quality.
Ensuring resourcing and leading the projects engineering, procurement and construction team.
Track project's scope, schedule and costs, and lead change management process.
Maintain a strategic focus for the project with frequent interaction with the stakeholders
Driving for project management best practices and efficient communication in order to create seamless and goal oriented teamwork in projects and organization.
Ensure that project execution shall fulfill requirements of law and authorities.
Maintain awareness of safety and environmental requirements.
Reporting projects' status according to agreed principles.

The best combination to succeed in this role

M.Sc. or B.Sc. in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in industrial project management and EPCM environment.
Previous experience from the process industry is preferred but not necessary.
Strong leadership skills and experience in leading people in a matrix organization.
Experienced in collaborating, influencing and engaging diverse, internal and external stakeholder groups.
For ensuring effective communication with all stakeholders, fluent communication skills in English and Finnish (verbal and written)

Other strengths we value

Project Management studies and certifications such as PMP or IPMA.
Understanding of contract administration, business principles and business law.

Let’s get you started

We look forward to receiving your CV and application by October 11th, 2026
. Please note that we will start reviewing applications already during the application period.

If you have any questions regarding the process or the position, please get in touch with Harri Soikkeli +358 50 458 3959 Manager, Project Management or Emilia Pekkala +358 50 458 9455 Manager, Project Management.

To ensure security and confidentiality, please submit your application through our recruitment system, as we are unable to consider applications sent via email. We will do our best to contact you within 2 weeks after the application time has ended. The recruitment process will include interviews and a potential aptitude assessment. The first interviews are preliminarily scheduled to take place on week 20. Depending on the position’s requirements, a security clearance and a drug test may be conducted with your consent.

Neste in brief

Neste (NESTE, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the world's leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), with production on three continents. The company’s renewables production capacity is expected to reach 6.8 million tons annually in 2027. Neste also produces high-quality oil products at its Porvoo refinery in Finland. The company has a network of nearly 1,000 fuel stations with expanding service offering, such as EV charging, in Finland and in the Baltics.

Neste’s strategy focuses on growth in renewable fuels, which help its customers to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. Neste is included in many international indices for its sustainability performance. In 2025, Neste's revenue stood at EUR 19.0 billion. Read more: neste.com

jobs.description:
Greenstepin analytiikkatiimissä työskentelee yli 60 huippuosaajaa ja liiketoimintamme kasvaa tasaista vauhtia. Haemme nyt uutta tiimikaveria!

Greenstep on vuonna 2010 perustettu suomalainen, perheomisteinen kasvuyritys, joka tarjoaa korkealaatuisia teknologia- ja back office -palveluita asiakkaidensa kehityksen ja menestyksen tueksi. Nykyään olemme yli 800 asiantuntijan yhteisö, joka toimii Pohjoismaissa ja muualla Euroopassa. Olemme kasvaneet orgaanisesti, ja tänä päivänä Greenstepiin kuuluu tekijöitä Suomessa, Ahvenanmaalla, Ruotsissa, Norjassa, Virossa, Tanskassa ja Alankomaissa. Meillä kaikilla on yhteinen tavoite auttaa kasvuyrityksiä tulemaan johtajiksi omilla toimialoillaan.

Kasvun myötä haemme lisää tekijöitä analytiikkatiimiimme Greenstepin asiakkaiden BI-ratkaisujen kehityksen tehtäviin!

Tehtäväkuvaus

Vedät ja kehität Power BI -projekteja Greenstepin asiakkaille. Vastaat projektien kokonaisuudesta joko itsenäisesti tai isomman tiimin kanssa: ratkaisun suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta, aikataulusta ja budjetista sekä siitä, että asiakas saa raporteista oikeasti hyötyä.

Työ ei kuitenkaan rajoitu raporttien rakentamiseen. Konsulttina pääset:

Kehittämään Power BI- ja Fabric-ratkaisuja asiakkaan liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin, semanttisista malleista valmiisiin raportteihin.
Toimimaan projektipäällikkönä: pilkot kokonaisuuden, ohjaat tiimiä, pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla ja viet projektin maaliin.
Työskentelemään advisory-roolissa: teet asiakkaille analytiikan nykytilakartoituksia, suunnittelet data-arkkitehtuuria, fasilitoit työpaljoja ja laadit kehityssuunnitelmia, joiden pohjalta asiakas tekee päätöksiä.

Pääset työskentelemään kiinnostavien asiakasyritysten kanssa, suomalaisista startupeista isompiin pörssiyrityksiin, ja apunasi toimii asiantunteva analytiikkatiimimme. Pääset myös mukaan kehittämään BI SaaS -palveluamme BI Bookia, jolla on jo satoja asiakkaita useissa eri maissa.

Olemme kasvava työyhteisö, missä uusia ideoita viedään vauhdilla eteenpäin ja jokainen greenstepiläinen pääsee kehittymään ammatillisesti. Hybridimallimme mukaisesti teemme töitä toimistoltamme käsin vähintään 50 % työajasta.

Voit lukea tästä artikkelin, jossa asiantuntijamme Antti Valtonen ja Juha Kapanen kertovat lisää analytiikkatiimistämme!

Edellytykset työssä menestymiseen

Olet kehityshaluinen ja tavoitteellinen asiantuntija. Olet tarkka työn yksityiskohdista, mutta hahmotat samalla isompia kokonaisuuksia ja osaat perustella ratkaisusi asiakkaalle. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista työotetta sekä rohkeutta kokeilla uusia ratkaisuja.

Toivomme sinulta:

Vahvaa Power BI -osaamista. DAX, M ja SQL ovat sinulle tuttuja kieliä. Käytät Power Queryä ja visualisoit raportteja ammattimaisella otteella. Haluat kehittyä huippuosaajaksi hyödyntäen uusimpia työkaluja ja ominaisuuksia.
Kokemusta projektien vetämisestä. Olet vastannut aikataulusta, laajuudesta ja asiakasviestinnästä, tai olet valmis ottamaan sen vastuun.
Kykyä toimia neuvonantajana. Osaat kartoittaa asiakkaan nykytilan, tunnistaa kehityskohteet ja esittää ne selkeästi. Työpajojen vetäminen ja kehityssuunnitelmien laatiminen kiinnostavat sinua.
Kokemusta tai kiinnostusta Microsoft Fabricista ja sen komponenteista, kuten Lakehouse, Data Factory ja Dataflows Gen2.
Liiketoiminnan raportoinnin osaamista. Keskustelet raportoinnin sisällöstä yhtä luontevasti talousjohtajan kuin teknisen johtajan kanssa. Talousraportointikokemus katsotaan eduksi.
Ymmärrystä tietovarastoinnista ja data-arkkitehtuurista. SQL, Python ja muu vastaava osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.
Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, esim. analytiikan, laskentatoimen, rahoituksen tai tietotekniikan KTM tai DI.
Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Viestit selkeästi ja proaktiivisesti eri sidosryhmille.
Tiimin sisäisenä työkielenä on englanti ja asiakastyöt tehdään pääsääntöisesti suomeksi.

Tiimi

Data- ja analytiikkatiimissämme työskentelee yli 60 asiantuntijaa
kolmessa maassa: data-analyytikkoja, data engineereja sekä muita data- ja AI-asiantuntijoita. Osaaminen kattaa koko ketjun ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, datan mallinnuksesta ja integraatioista valmiisiin analytiikkaratkaisuihin, ja kokoamme jokaiseen projektiin tarvittavan kokoonpanon.

Tähän joukkoon kuuluu yli 30 analytiikkakonsulttia, BI Bookin oma tuotekehitystiimi, Greenstepin sisäisestä BI-kehityksestä vastaava tiimi sekä muita datakonsultteja.
Tuotekehityksen ja asiakasprojektien oppi kulkee jatkuvasti molempiin suuntiin, ja oman sisäisen kehityksen kautta näemme päivittäin, miten ratkaisut toimivat käytännössä.

Tiimin osaamisesta pidetään huolta jatkuvilla koulutuksilla,
ja kannustamme aktiivisesti työntekijöitä hankkimaan alaan liittyviä sertifikaatteja
.

Osaksi Greenstepin perheyhtiötä

Greenstep Oy on vuonna 2010 perustettu perheyhtiö, joka tarjoaa laadukkaita palveluita tukemaan asiakkaidensa liiketoimintaa ja kasvua. Jokainen greenstepiläinen on meille tärkeä ja haluamme mielenkiintoisten tehtävien lisäksi tarjota erinomaiset työsuhteet kaikille. Meillä pääset osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa asiantuntijuus, vastuullisuus ja toisista välittäminen näkyy. Koko Greenstepin laajuisesti meitä on jo yli 700 asiantuntijan verkosto! Yhdessä menemme eteenpäin kerryttäen samalla myös henkilökohtaista substanssiosaamistamme.

. Meille jokaisen työssä jaksaminen ja hyvinvointi ovat ykkösprioriteetteja. Työterveytemme on kattava ja toimistomme ovat ergonomisesti suunniteltuja. Epassin kautta tarjottu Flex-etu ja lounasvähennys ovat käytössäsi. Ykkösasia työhyvinvointiasi tukemassa on kuitenkin kestävällä tavalla rakennettu resurssibudjetti.

Greenstepillä jatkuva oppiminen on tekemisen ytimessä. Säännölliset ajankohtaiskoulutukset ovat osa arkeamme kirjanpitotiimissä ja Greenstepin Academyn kautta tuemme sinua niin tilinpäätöksissä, vero-osaamisessa kuin esimerkiksi KLT-tutkinnon saavuttamisessa, kuin sen ylläpidossa!

Kasvamme orgaanisesti ja vastuullisesti. Kulttuurimme on kehittynyt yhteisesti vuosien saatossa ja arvomme näkyvät jokapäiväisessä työssämme. Olemme vakavarainen perheyhtiö, ja meille on ensiarvoisen tärkeää luoda jatkuvuutta ja turvallisuutta kaikille Greenstepiläisille.

Kiinnostuitko meistä ja tehtävästä?

Sijainnin suhteen toivotamme sinut tervetulleeksi mistä tahansa Greenstepin Suomen toimipisteeltä. Hybridimallimme

Greenstep on vuonna 2010 perustettu suomalainen, perheomisteinen kasvuyritys, joka tarjoaa korkealaatuisia teknologia- ja back office -palveluita asiakkaidensa kehityksen ja menestyksen tueksi. Nykyään olemme yli 800 asiantuntijan yhteisö, joka toimii Pohjoismaissa ja muualla Euroopassa. Olemme kasvaneet orgaanisesti, ja tänä päivänä Greenstepiin kuuluu tekijöitä Suomessa, Ahvenanmaalla, Ruotsissa, Norjassa, Virossa, Tanskassa ja Alankomaissa. Meillä kaikilla on yhteinen tavoite auttaa kasvuyrityksiä tulemaan johtajiksi omilla toimialoillaan.

Kasvun myötä haemme lisää tekijöitä analytiikkatiimiimme Greenstepin asiakkaiden BI-ratkaisujen kehityksen tehtäviin!

Tehtäväkuvaus

Vedät ja kehität Power BI -projekteja Greenstepin asiakkaille. Vastaat projektien kokonaisuudesta joko itsenäisesti tai isomman tiimin kanssa: ratkaisun suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta, aikataulusta ja budjetista sekä siitä, että asiakas saa raporteista oikeasti hyötyä.

Työ ei kuitenkaan rajoitu raporttien rakentamiseen. Konsulttina pääset:

Kehittämään Power BI- ja Fabric-ratkaisuja asiakkaan liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin, semanttisista malleista valmiisiin raportteihin.
Toimimaan projektipäällikkönä: pilkot kokonaisuuden, ohjaat tiimiä, pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla ja viet projektin maaliin.
Työskentelemään advisory-roolissa: teet asiakkaille analytiikan nykytilakartoituksia, suunnittelet data-arkkitehtuuria, fasilitoit työpaljoja ja laadit kehityssuunnitelmia, joiden pohjalta asiakas tekee päätöksiä.

Pääset työskentelemään kiinnostavien asiakasyritysten kanssa, suomalaisista startupeista isompiin pörssiyrityksiin, ja apunasi toimii asiantunteva analytiikkatiimimme. Pääset myös mukaan kehittämään BI SaaS -palveluamme BI Bookia, jolla on jo satoja asiakkaita useissa eri maissa.

Olemme kasvava työyhteisö, missä uusia ideoita viedään vauhdilla eteenpäin ja jokainen greenstepiläinen pääsee kehittymään ammatillisesti. Hybridimallimme mukaisesti teemme töitä toimistoltamme käsin vähintään 50 % työajasta.

Voit lukea tästä artikkelin, jossa asiantuntijamme Antti Valtonen ja Juha Kapanen kertovat lisää analytiikkatiimistämme!

Edellytykset työssä menestymiseen

Olet kehityshaluinen ja tavoitteellinen asiantuntija. Olet tarkka työn yksityiskohdista, mutta hahmotat samalla isompia kokonaisuuksia ja osaat perustella ratkaisusi asiakkaalle. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista työotetta sekä rohkeutta kokeilla uusia ratkaisuja.

Toivomme sinulta:

Vahvaa Power BI -osaamista. DAX, M ja SQL ovat sinulle tuttuja kieliä. Käytät Power Queryä ja visualisoit raportteja ammattimaisella otteella. Haluat kehittyä huippuosaajaksi hyödyntäen uusimpia työkaluja ja ominaisuuksia.
Kokemusta projektien vetämisestä. Olet vastannut aikataulusta, laajuudesta ja asiakasviestinnästä, tai olet valmis ottamaan sen vastuun.
Kykyä toimia neuvonantajana. Osaat kartoittaa asiakkaan nykytilan, tunnistaa kehityskohteet ja esittää ne selkeästi. Työpajojen vetäminen ja kehityssuunnitelmien laatiminen kiinnostavat sinua.
Kokemusta tai kiinnostusta Microsoft Fabricista ja sen komponenteista, kuten Lakehouse, Data Factory ja Dataflows Gen2.
Liiketoiminnan raportoinnin osaamista. Keskustelet raportoinnin sisällöstä yhtä luontevasti talousjohtajan kuin teknisen johtajan kanssa. Talousraportointikokemus katsotaan eduksi.
Ymmärrystä tietovarastoinnista ja data-arkkitehtuurista. SQL, Python ja muu vastaava osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.
Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, esim. analytiikan, laskentatoimen, rahoituksen tai tietotekniikan KTM tai DI.
Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Viestit selkeästi ja proaktiivisesti eri sidosryhmille.
Tiimin sisäisenä työkielenä on englanti ja asiakastyöt tehdään pääsääntöisesti suomeksi.

Tiimi

Data- ja analytiikkatiimissämme työskentelee yli 60 asiantuntijaa
kolmessa maassa: data-analyytikkoja, data engineereja sekä muita data- ja AI-asiantuntijoita. Osaaminen kattaa koko ketjun ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, datan mallinnuksesta ja integraatioista valmiisiin analytiikkaratkaisuihin, ja kokoamme jokaiseen projektiin tarvittavan kokoonpanon.

Tähän joukkoon kuuluu yli 30 analytiikkakonsulttia, BI Bookin oma tuotekehitystiimi, Greenstepin sisäisestä BI-kehityksestä vastaava tiimi sekä muita datakonsultteja.
Tuotekehityksen ja asiakasprojektien oppi kulkee jatkuvasti molempiin suuntiin, ja oman sisäisen kehityksen kautta näemme päivittäin, miten ratkaisut toimivat käytännössä.

Tiimin osaamisesta pidetään huolta jatkuvilla koulutuksilla,
ja kannustamme aktiivisesti työntekijöitä hankkimaan alaan liittyviä sertifikaatteja
.

Osaksi Greenstepin perheyhtiötä

Greenstep Oy on vuonna 2010 perustettu perheyhtiö, joka tarjoaa laadukkaita palveluita tukemaan asiakkaidensa liiketoimintaa ja kasvua. Jokainen greenstepiläinen on meille tärkeä ja haluamme mielenkiintoisten tehtävien lisäksi tarjota erinomaiset työsuhteet kaikille. Meillä pääset osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa asiantuntijuus, vastuullisuus ja toisista välittäminen näkyy. Koko Greenstepin laajuisesti meitä on jo yli 700 asiantuntijan verkosto! Yhdessä menemme eteenpäin kerryttäen samalla myös henkilökohtaista substanssiosaamistamme.

Greensteppiläisenä saat:

💚
Tukea hyvinvointiisi
. Meille jokaisen työssä jaksaminen ja hyvinvointi ovat ykkösprioriteetteja. Työterveytemme on kattava ja toimistomme ovat ergonomisesti suunniteltuja. Epassin kautta tarjottu Flex-etu ja lounasvähennys ovat käytössäsi. Ykkösasia työhyvinvointiasi tukemassa on kuitenkin kestävällä tavalla rakennettu resurssibudjetti.

💚 Vastuitasi ja kokemustasi vastaavan kuukausipalkan.
Kaikki Greenstepiläiset kuuluvat myös Together-bonuksemme piiriin, jonka kautta jaamme vuotuisesta liikevoitosta 10 % roolista riippumatta kaikkien työntekijöiden kesken.

💚
Tukea ja aikaa kehittymiselle ja osaamisen vahvistamiselle.
Greenstepillä jatkuva oppiminen on tekemisen ytimessä. Säännölliset ajankohtaiskoulutukset ovat osa arkeamme kirjanpitotiimissä ja Greenstepin Academyn kautta tuemme sinua niin tilinpäätöksissä, vero-osaamisessa kuin esimerkiksi KLT-tutkinnon saavuttamisessa, kuin sen ylläpidossa!

💚
Uramahdollisuuden kasvavassa perheomisteisessa yrityksessä.
Kasvamme orgaanisesti ja vastuullisesti. Kulttuurimme on kehittynyt yhteisesti vuosien saatossa ja arvomme näkyvät jokapäiväisessä työssämme. Olemme vakavarainen perheyhtiö, ja meille on ensiarvoisen tärkeää luoda jatkuvuutta ja turvallisuutta kaikille Greenstepiläisille.

Kiinnostuitko meistä ja tehtävästä?

Kasvun myötä haemme lisää osaavia ammattilaisia ympäri Suomen. Greenstep on modernisti toimiva ja monipuolisesti palveleva yritysten kumppani. Meillä on Suomessa noin 15 toimipistettä sekä lisäksi toimimme Virossa, Ahvenanmaalla, Ruotsissa, Norjassa, Tanskassa ja Hollannissa. Sijainnin suhteen toivotamme sinut tervetulleeksi mistä tahansa Greenstepin Suomen toimipisteeltä. Hybridimallimme

jobs.title: Senior Staff Program Manager, Creator Partnerships
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Creators are people who build audiences across the internet: influential voices whose communities listen to them and want to spend time together. Many of those communities already live on Discord, but our relationship with creators has grown organically. We have an opportunity to listen more closely, serve them more intentionally, and build a relationship that reflects the role they play on our platform.

We’re hiring a Senior Staff Program Manager to build Discord’s approach to creators from the ground up. You’ll begin with a selected group of creators already using Discord, build the fundamentals that serve them well, and develop programs that make their experience on Discord better. Over time, you’ll turn what works into programs that can serve creators at scale and, eventually, give new creators more reasons to choose Discord. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can lead through judgment, relationships, and execution. You’ll report to the Director of Marketing, Player Communications and partner closely with Support, Product, Marketing, Communications, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

What You'll Be Doing

Build Discord’s creator strategy from the bottom up, starting with direct conversations and a clear understanding of what creators already on Discord need from us.
Bring together the creator work that exists across Discord today, establish clear ownership, and turn a collection of early efforts into a coherent program.
Define who we mean by creators and develop an initial approach for selecting and serving a trusted group across games, platforms, formats, and communities.
Create more than one program for creators, beginning with the fundamentals: accelerated support, clear paths for escalation, and reliable channels for two-way communication.
Manage relationships with important creators directly. Understand how they use Discord, help them solve meaningful problems, and build trust by following through.
Build a creator council or network that gives us a consistent view of what creators are seeing, where Discord is falling short, and what would make the platform more useful to them and their communities.
Build systems and playbooks that let a selected program grow over time without losing the relationships and responsiveness that made it valuable.

What You Should Have

A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the creators and communities we serve.
7+ years in creator partnerships, community, platform programs, marketing, product partnerships, or a related field.
Deeply familiar with how creators build audiences, operate their businesses, and manage communities across platforms like YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, Patreon, Reddit, and Discord.
You have built and operated creator or partner programs at scale, and you understand how to begin with a selected group without designing something that can never grow beyond it.
Biased to ship and iterate. You can launch a useful first version, learn from it, and raise the ambition over time.
Comfortable leading as an individual contributor. You create alignment and momentum across teams without relying on headcount or reporting lines.
An excellent cross-functional partner across Support, Product, Marketing, Comms, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

Bonus Points

You have built a creator, partner, ambassador, advisory, or VIP program for a consumer platform.
You have designed accelerated support or escalation programs for influential users.
You have worked directly with gaming creators and understand the relationship between creators, games, and communities.
You have built programs involving product access, creator events, recognition, or discovery.
You have helped turn creator feedback into product changes, policies, or platform strategy.
You have built a program that began with a small trusted group and expanded without losing what made it valuable.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $256,000 to $288,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

Overview

Ability to work independently with limited supervision Ability to work well with people from different disciplines with varying degrees of technical experience
ITIL certification is preferred
Working experience on other ITSM tools is an advantage

Responsible For

Partnering with business users to gather all requirements to formulate business specifications and translating those into business functionality.
Documenting workflows and results of business analysis and obtaining sign-off from users on specifications. Creating user story, acceptance criteria, the definition of ready and definition of done in the agile framework
Assisting the technical team in translating application functionality into application architecture and the production of a business functionality requirements statement.
Communicating the business directives, goals, and needs to the technical team and serving as business interface from the solution delivery team managing expectations and defining business satisfaction metrics.
Designing and executing test plans to ensure that business requirements and functional specifications are implemented properly and meet ROI objectives.
Participate in planning initiatives, feasibility studies, cost/benefit analysis, and new systems design.
Work with the QA team to prepare test scenarios and data. Document and manage business and functional requirements. Review user stories and acceptance criteria.
Provide thought leadership in one of the functional areas, handle queries and competency building in the respective functional areas. Provide functional solution and clarification on the inter-module dependencies.
Determine a project’s requirements by extracting them from business or government policies, as well as from current and future users, through interaction and research.
Anticipate future requirements to ensure successful outcomes. Constrain requirements when necessary and focus on core business needs, rather than users’ personal preferences, functions related to trends or outdated processes, or other non-essential modifications. Organize requirements into related categories to effectively manage and communicate them.
Use robust analysis and modeling tools to match strategic business objectives with practical technical solutions.
At regular intervals in the project life cycle, safeguard and protect the business and user’s needs by verifying functionality, accuracy and completeness of the requirements against the original documents. Safeguarding minimizes risk by ensuring requirements are being met before investing further in system development.
Emphasize simplicity and ease of use at all times, especially in implementation.
Identify and avoid extraneous activities that do not solve the problem or help reach the objective.
The business analyst is most knowledgeable about use cases; therefore, they continually verify the requirements and reject implementations that do not advance business objectives.
In application maintenance, the focus is on preventing and correcting defects; enhancements or making changes to increase the value provided by the system.

Provide post-implementation support, troubleshooting, and subject matter expertise to ensure successful adoption of implemented solutions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Advanced troubleshooting, configuration, and application support skills with Infor LN.

Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and business analysis best practices.
Experience working within Agile and project delivery methodologies.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset.

Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related)

new_jobs.description:
Reports to: Associate Director, Certifications
Location: Pacific NW preferred (Hybrid: PDX Metro Area, Remote: Outside of PDX Metro Area)
Classification: Full-time, Exempt
Job Ladder Classification: Manager
Job Close Date: Applications received by 9/14/2026 will be prioritized. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

Who we’re looking for

You are an experienced project manager who is comfortable supporting complex new multifamily development projects. You possess sound technical judgment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to guide multidisciplinary teams toward successful project outcomes. You are motivated to support the regional housing industry, and are comfortable working with affordable housing organizations, developers, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, public agencies, and internal technical specialists. 

You have a strong foundation in multifamily construction and building science, an ability to learn technical standards, and the judgment to know when to independently resolve an issue and when to engage additional technical expertise. You do not need to be an expert in each green building certification program on day one. However, you will be able to translate complex certification and technical requirements into clear priorities, decisions, and next steps for project teams. 

This position is primarily a project management role focused on the successful delivery of multifamily green building certification projects, including technical review, certification coordination, client support, and internal process management. You will work closely with our field verification and energy modeling staff to deliver successful project outcomes. While this position is not primarily responsible for field verification or energy modeling, opportunities to contribute technical expertise may arise based on organizational needs and individual experience.

You may have opportunities to represent Earth Advantage as a technical subject matter expert in client education events, workforce trainings, conference presentations, workshops, research initiatives, and other industry engagement activities throughout the PNW.

What you’ll be doing

Project Management: 

Serve as the primary project manager and client contact for assigned multifamily certification projects from design through final certification.
Manage a portfolio of multifamily projects pursuing Earth Advantage Multifamily, LEED for Homes, and/or other recognized green building and energy certifications.
Develop and manage project schedules, certification milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and deadlines. Ensure all project communications, documentation, and deliverables are complete, accurate, clear and professionally presented. 
Coordinate certification services associated with affordable housing funding, incentive, financing, tax credit, or verifier requirements when included within the project scope.
Maintain accurate project information within Earth Advantage's customer relationship management, project management, and file management systems.

Technical Review & Certification: 

Review construction drawings, specifications, product data, cut sheets, approved submittals, and other project documentation for certification compliance.  
Understand the interaction between certification requirements, project design decisions, construction practices, and building performance.
Coordinate with Earth Advantage field verification staff to ensure required inspections, testing, checklists, and supporting documentation are completed at appropriate project milestones.
Collaborate with energy modeling staff to coordinate project information, assumptions, design changes, documentation, and modeling deliverables.

Client Support & Industry Engagement: 

Support affordable housing organizations and project teams in navigating certification requirements associated with high-performance and sustainable housing goals.
Build productive, long-term relationships with developers, affordable housing organizations, architects, engineers, contractors, and other project partners.
Explain complex technical and certification requirements in ways that are understandable and actionable for different audiences.
Participate in relevant client meetings, conferences, industry events, and occasional project site visits.  

Internal Operations: 

Support the successful delivery and continuous improvement of Earth Advantage's multifamily certification programs by strengthening operational processes, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
Assist in developing, documenting, and improving certification workflows, project management procedures, templates, and internal tools. 
Identify recurring process challenges and recommend practical improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency, quality, and client experience. 
Contribute to organizational knowledge by documenting technical interpretations, lessons learned, and effective practices.

Required qualifications

Demonstrated commitment to Earth Advantage's mission and values. 
Five or more years of relevant professional experience in multifamily construction, architecture, engineering, construction management, sustainability, building performance, affordable housing, or a related field, including significant responsibility for managing projects, clients, schedules, or multidisciplinary teams. 
Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple complex projects, competing priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines. 
Strong working knowledge of multifamily construction and building science, including the ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, submittals, and other technical documentation. 
Strong analytical judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to research technical questions, evaluate information, and determine appropriate next steps. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary technical teams. 
Ability and willingness to learn new technical standards, certification requirements, and workflows and to travel periodically throughout the Pacific Northwest.

Preferred qualifications

Seven or more years of experience managing multifamily construction, design, sustainability consulting, building performance, affordable housing, or similarly complex projects. 
Experience working with affordable housing developers, owners, funders, or project teams. 
Experience supporting projects that successfully achieved green building, energy, or high-performance building certifications. 
Experience with one or more programs such as Earth Advantage Multifamily, LEED for Homes, ENERGY STAR Multifamily New Construction, Enterprise Green Communities, PHIUS/Passive House, or comparable programs. 
Relevant professional credentials such as LEED Green Associate or LEED AP, RESNET HERS Rater or applicable multifamily credential, BPI Multifamily, PHIUS Certified Verifier, or similar. 
Experience collaborating with energy modeling professionals and an understanding of whole-building energy modeling workflows (e.g., IESVE or equivalent) and how modeling informs design decisions, code compliance, and green building certifications.
Experience reviewing construction documents for certification, sustainability, quality assurance, code, or similar compliance requirements. 
Familiarity with project management and document-review platforms such as Monday.com, Bluebeam, Microsoft 365, or comparable tools. 
Experience working with funding, incentive, tax credit, financing, or verification requirements associated with affordable or high-performance housing. 
Interest or experience sharing technical knowledge through client education, workshops, presentations, contractor training, research initiatives, or other subject matter expert activities.

$78,000 - $103,000 annual compensation. 
Note: This range represents the compensation opportunity within this specific Earth Advantage job class. Compensation for new hires generally falls in the low to mid point of the pay range. 

Benefits

Earth Advantage offers an excellent benefit package including: 
5 weeks PTO + 8 paid holidays
80% employer paid medical and dental premiums
Deductible reimbursement program through our HRA
FSA for medical, transit, parking, and dependent care
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
401k plan with match
Life insurance, short term and long-term disability insurance 
Fully paid family leave
6 week sabbatical opportunity after 5 years

Applications received by 09/14/2026 will be prioritized. Finalists must have eligibility to work in the US as Earth Advantage is not able to provide VISA sponsorship or have remote work outside of the US.

Resume
Cover letter (optional)

We are looking for you,

Project Manager

to join our Investment Project Management team located in Porvoo.

As a Project Manager you will be leading and managing the project team, scope, resources, time, cost and change management. Strong networking and communication skills are necessary to ensure efficient communication and information sharing between internal and external project stakeholders.

Reasons to join

We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate.

We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment.

Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging.

In addition, our benefits
for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, good occupational health care, a membership in a sickness or health insurance fund and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure time activities, e.g. by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi).

The job is located in Kilpilahti, Porvoo, which is about 30 minutes by car from the center of Helsinki. We organize free bus transportation to Kilpilahti for our employees from the capital region, Porvoo and the nearby areas.

More about the job

Your role in our team

Project Manager is accountable for overall delivery of assigned projects including following:

Manage the projects according to Neste operating model safely in compliance with agreed project scope, schedule, cost and quality.
Ensuring resourcing and leading the projects engineering, procurement and construction team.
Track project's scope, schedule and costs, and lead change management process.
Maintain a strategic focus for the project with frequent interaction with the stakeholders
Driving for project management best practices and efficient communication in order to create seamless and goal oriented teamwork in projects and organization.
Ensure that project execution shall fulfill requirements of law and authorities.
Maintain awareness of safety and environmental requirements.
Reporting projects' status according to agreed principles.

The best combination to succeed in this role

M.Sc. or B.Sc. in engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in industrial project management and EPCM environment.
Previous experience from the process industry is preferred but not necessary.
Strong leadership skills and experience in leading people in a matrix organization.
Experienced in collaborating, influencing and engaging diverse, internal and external stakeholder groups.
For ensuring effective communication with all stakeholders, fluent communication skills in English and Finnish (verbal and written)

Other strengths we value

Project Management studies and certifications such as PMP or IPMA.
Understanding of contract administration, business principles and business law.

Let’s get you started

We look forward to receiving your CV and application by October 11th, 2026
. Please note that we will start reviewing applications already during the application period.

Neste (NESTE, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the world's leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), with production on three continents. new_jobs.description:
Greenstepin analytiikkatiimissä työskentelee yli 60 huippuosaajaa ja liiketoimintamme kasvaa tasaista vauhtia. Haemme nyt uutta tiimikaveria!

Greenstep on vuonna 2010 perustettu suomalainen, perheomisteinen kasvuyritys, joka tarjoaa korkealaatuisia teknologia- ja back office -palveluita asiakkaidensa kehityksen ja menestyksen tueksi. Nykyään olemme yli 800 asiantuntijan yhteisö, joka toimii Pohjoismaissa ja muualla Euroopassa. Olemme kasvaneet orgaanisesti, ja tänä päivänä Greenstepiin kuuluu tekijöitä Suomessa, Ahvenanmaalla, Ruotsissa, Norjassa, Virossa, Tanskassa ja Alankomaissa. Meillä kaikilla on yhteinen tavoite auttaa kasvuyrityksiä tulemaan johtajiksi omilla toimialoillaan.

Kasvun myötä haemme lisää tekijöitä analytiikkatiimiimme Greenstepin asiakkaiden BI-ratkaisujen kehityksen tehtäviin!

Tehtäväkuvaus

Vedät ja kehität Power BI -projekteja Greenstepin asiakkaille. Vastaat projektien kokonaisuudesta joko itsenäisesti tai isomman tiimin kanssa: ratkaisun suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta, aikataulusta ja budjetista sekä siitä, että asiakas saa raporteista oikeasti hyötyä.

Työ ei kuitenkaan rajoitu raporttien rakentamiseen. Konsulttina pääset:

Kehittämään Power BI- ja Fabric-ratkaisuja asiakkaan liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin, semanttisista malleista valmiisiin raportteihin.
Toimimaan projektipäällikkönä: pilkot kokonaisuuden, ohjaat tiimiä, pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla ja viet projektin maaliin.
Työskentelemään advisory-roolissa: teet asiakkaille analytiikan nykytilakartoituksia, suunnittelet data-arkkitehtuuria, fasilitoit työpaljoja ja laadit kehityssuunnitelmia, joiden pohjalta asiakas tekee päätöksiä.

Pääset työskentelemään kiinnostavien asiakasyritysten kanssa, suomalaisista startupeista isompiin pörssiyrityksiin, ja apunasi toimii asiantunteva analytiikkatiimimme. Pääset myös mukaan kehittämään BI SaaS -palveluamme BI Bookia, jolla on jo satoja asiakkaita useissa eri maissa.

Olemme kasvava työyhteisö, missä uusia ideoita viedään vauhdilla eteenpäin ja jokainen greenstepiläinen pääsee kehittymään ammatillisesti. Hybridimallimme mukaisesti teemme töitä toimistoltamme käsin vähintään 50 % työajasta.

Voit lukea tästä artikkelin, jossa asiantuntijamme Antti Valtonen ja Juha Kapanen kertovat lisää analytiikkatiimistämme!

Edellytykset työssä menestymiseen

Olet kehityshaluinen ja tavoitteellinen asiantuntija. Olet tarkka työn yksityiskohdista, mutta hahmotat samalla isompia kokonaisuuksia ja osaat perustella ratkaisusi asiakkaalle. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista työotetta sekä rohkeutta kokeilla uusia ratkaisuja.

Toivomme sinulta:

Vahvaa Power BI -osaamista. DAX, M ja SQL ovat sinulle tuttuja kieliä. Käytät Power Queryä ja visualisoit raportteja ammattimaisella otteella. Haluat kehittyä huippuosaajaksi hyödyntäen uusimpia työkaluja ja ominaisuuksia.
Kokemusta projektien vetämisestä. Olet vastannut aikataulusta, laajuudesta ja asiakasviestinnästä, tai olet valmis ottamaan sen vastuun.
Kykyä toimia neuvonantajana. Osaat kartoittaa asiakkaan nykytilan, tunnistaa kehityskohteet ja esittää ne selkeästi. Työpajojen vetäminen ja kehityssuunnitelmien laatiminen kiinnostavat sinua.
Kokemusta tai kiinnostusta Microsoft Fabricista ja sen komponenteista, kuten Lakehouse, Data Factory ja Dataflows Gen2.
Liiketoiminnan raportoinnin osaamista. Keskustelet raportoinnin sisällöstä yhtä luontevasti talousjohtajan kuin teknisen johtajan kanssa. Talousraportointikokemus katsotaan eduksi.
Ymmärrystä tietovarastoinnista ja data-arkkitehtuurista. SQL, Python ja muu vastaava osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.
Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, esim. analytiikan, laskentatoimen, rahoituksen tai tietotekniikan KTM tai DI.
Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Viestit selkeästi ja proaktiivisesti eri sidosryhmille.
Tiimin sisäisenä työkielenä on englanti ja asiakastyöt tehdään pääsääntöisesti suomeksi.

Tiimi

Data- ja analytiikkatiimissämme työskentelee yli 60 asiantuntijaa
kolmessa maassa: data-analyytikkoja, data engineereja sekä muita data- ja AI-asiantuntijoita. Osaaminen kattaa koko ketjun ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, datan mallinnuksesta ja integraatioista valmiisiin analytiikkaratkaisuihin, ja kokoamme jokaiseen projektiin tarvittavan kokoonpanon.

Tähän joukkoon kuuluu yli 30 analytiikkakonsulttia, BI Bookin oma tuotekehitystiimi, Greenstepin sisäisestä BI-kehityksestä vastaava tiimi sekä muita datakonsultteja.
Tuotekehityksen ja asiakasprojektien oppi kulkee jatkuvasti molempiin suuntiin, ja oman sisäisen kehityksen kautta näemme päivittäin, miten ratkaisut toimivat käytännössä.

Tiimin osaamisesta pidetään huolta jatkuvilla koulutuksilla,
ja kannustamme aktiivisesti työntekijöitä hankkimaan alaan liittyviä sertifikaatteja
.

Osaksi Greenstepin perheyhtiötä

Greenstep Oy on vuonna 2010 perustettu perheyhtiö, joka tarjoaa laadukkaita palveluita tukemaan asiakkaidensa liiketoimintaa ja kasvua. Jokainen greenstepiläinen on meille tärkeä ja haluamme mielenkiintoisten tehtävien lisäksi tarjota erinomaiset työsuhteet kaikille. Meillä pääset osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa asiantuntijuus, vastuullisuus ja toisista välittäminen näkyy. Koko Greenstepin laajuisesti meitä on jo yli 700 asiantuntijan verkosto! Yhdessä menemme eteenpäin kerryttäen samalla myös henkilökohtaista substanssiosaamistamme.

Greensteppiläisenä saat:

💚
Tukea hyvinvointiisi
. Meille jokaisen työssä jaksaminen ja hyvinvointi ovat ykkösprioriteetteja. Työterveytemme on kattava ja toimistomme ovat ergonomisesti suunniteltuja. Epassin kautta tarjottu Flex-etu ja lounasvähennys ovat käytössäsi. Ykkösasia työhyvinvointiasi tukemassa on kuitenkin kestävällä tavalla rakennettu resurssibudjetti.

💚 Vastuitasi ja kokemustasi vastaavan kuukausipalkan.
Kaikki Greenstepiläiset kuuluvat myös Together-bonuksemme piiriin, jonka kautta jaamme vuotuisesta liikevoitosta 10 % roolista riippumatta kaikkien työntekijöiden kesken.

💚
Tukea ja aikaa kehittymiselle ja osaamisen vahvistamiselle.
Greenstepillä jatkuva oppiminen on tekemisen ytimessä. Säännölliset ajankohtaiskoulutukset ovat osa arkeamme kirjanpitotiimissä ja Greenstepin Academyn kautta tuemme sinua niin tilinpäätöksissä, vero-osaamisessa kuin esimerkiksi KLT-tutkinnon saavuttamisessa, kuin sen ylläpidossa!

💚
Uramahdollisuuden kasvavassa perheomisteisessa yrityksessä.
Kasvamme orgaanisesti ja vastuullisesti. Kulttuurimme on kehittynyt yhteisesti vuosien saatossa ja arvomme näkyvät jokapäiväisessä työssämme. Olemme vakavarainen perheyhtiö, ja meille on ensiarvoisen tärkeää luoda jatkuvuutta ja turvallisuutta kaikille Greenstepiläisille.

Kiinnostuitko meistä ja tehtävästä?

Kasvun myötä haemme lisää osaavia ammattilaisia ympäri Suomen. Greenstep on modernisti toimiva ja monipuolisesti palveleva yritysten kumppani. Meillä on Suomessa noin 15 toimipistettä sekä lisäksi toimimme Virossa, Ahvenanmaalla, Ruotsissa, Norjassa, Tanskassa ja Hollannissa. Sijainnin suhteen toivotamme sinut tervetulleeksi mistä tahansa Greenstepin Suomen toimipisteeltä. Hybridimallimme
mukaisesti teemme töitä toimistolta käsin vähintään 50% työajasta.

Hakuaika päättyy 4.10.2026.
Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana, joten odotamme innolla kuulevamme sinusta pian!

Pääset tutustumaan meihin lisää myös täällä: https://greenstep.fi/rekrytointi/kulttuuri

Osana rekryprosessiamme teemme yleensä kolme haastattelukierrosta. Työhön valittavilta soitetaan suosittelijat ja tarkistetaan luottotiedot.

new_jobs.title: Senior Staff Program Manager, Creator Partnerships
new_jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Creators are people who build audiences across the internet: influential voices whose communities listen to them and want to spend time together. Many of those communities already live on Discord, but our relationship with creators has grown organically. We have an opportunity to listen more closely, serve them more intentionally, and build a relationship that reflects the role they play on our platform.

We’re hiring a Senior Staff Program Manager to build Discord’s approach to creators from the ground up. You’ll begin with a selected group of creators already using Discord, build the fundamentals that serve them well, and develop programs that make their experience on Discord better. Over time, you’ll turn what works into programs that can serve creators at scale and, eventually, give new creators more reasons to choose Discord. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can lead through judgment, relationships, and execution. You’ll report to the Director of Marketing, Player Communications and partner closely with Support, Product, Marketing, Communications, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

What You'll Be Doing

Build Discord’s creator strategy from the bottom up, starting with direct conversations and a clear understanding of what creators already on Discord need from us.
Bring together the creator work that exists across Discord today, establish clear ownership, and turn a collection of early efforts into a coherent program.
Define who we mean by creators and develop an initial approach for selecting and serving a trusted group across games, platforms, formats, and communities.
Create more than one program for creators, beginning with the fundamentals: accelerated support, clear paths for escalation, and reliable channels for two-way communication.
Manage relationships with important creators directly. Understand how they use Discord, help them solve meaningful problems, and build trust by following through.
Build a creator council or network that gives us a consistent view of what creators are seeing, where Discord is falling short, and what would make the platform more useful to them and their communities.
Build systems and playbooks that let a selected program grow over time without losing the relationships and responsiveness that made it valuable.

What You Should Have

A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the creators and communities we serve.
7+ years in creator partnerships, community, platform programs, marketing, product partnerships, or a related field.
Deeply familiar with how creators build audiences, operate their businesses, and manage communities across platforms like YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, Patreon, Reddit, and Discord.
You have built and operated creator or partner programs at scale, and you understand how to begin with a selected group without designing something that can never grow beyond it.
Biased to ship and iterate. You can launch a useful first version, learn from it, and raise the ambition over time.
Comfortable leading as an individual contributor. You create alignment and momentum across teams without relying on headcount or reporting lines.
An excellent cross-functional partner across Support, Product, Marketing, Comms, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

Bonus Points

You have built a creator, partner, ambassador, advisory, or VIP program for a consumer platform.
You have designed accelerated support or escalation programs for influential users.
You have worked directly with gaming creators and understand the relationship between creators, games, and communities.
You have built programs involving product access, creator events, recognition, or discovery.
You have helped turn creator feedback into product changes, policies, or platform strategy.
You have built a program that began with a small trusted group and expanded without losing what made it valuable.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $256,000 to $288,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Đóng vai trò BA Leader/Lead Consultant trong các dự án triển khai chuyển đổi số quy mô lớn cho Ngân hàng, Tổ chức tài chính và doanh nghiệp; chịu trách nhiệm định hướng nghiệp vụ, quản trị phạm vi và đảm bảo chất lượng đầu ra của đội ngũ BA.
Chủ trì làm việc với khách hàng, tư vấn và khơi gợi nhu cầu nghiệp vụ (domain Banking, Finance), đề xuất các giải pháp chuyển đổi số phù hợp bao gồm nhưng không giới hạn: CRM, LOS, AI Chatbot, OCR, Loyalty, ECM, IBM và các nền tảng số khác.
Dẫn dắt quá trình business discovery, requirement elicitation, solution consulting, phân tích bài toán hiện trạng (AS-IS), thiết kế mô hình mục tiêu (TO-BE), đề xuất roadmap triển khai và chiến lược chuyển đổi.
Chịu trách nhiệm quản lý và điều phối hoạt động BA trong dự án: phân công công việc, kiểm soát tiến độ, chất lượng tài liệu, quản lý thay đổi yêu cầu (Requirement Change Management), quản lý phạm vi và rủi ro nghiệp vụ.

Chủ trì phân tích nghiệp vụ, xây dựng mô hình quy trình, xây dựng solution blueprint và triển khai các dự án cho Ngân hàng/Tổ chức tài chính trong nước và quốc tế.
Chịu trách nhiệm review, chuẩn hóa và sign-off các tài liệu nghiệp vụ như BRD, URD, FRD, User Story, Functional Specification, Process Flow, UAT/Test Scenario cùng các tài liệu liên quan.
Định hướng thiết kế trải nghiệm và nghiệp vụ thông qua việc xây dựng Mockup/Prototype, tổ chức workshop và present giải pháp nhằm thống nhất thiết kế với khách hàng.

Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin/Hệ thống thông tin hoặc các ngành có liên quan khác.

Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm tư vấn, triển khai các giải pháp lớn cho Tổ chức ngân hàng, tài chính (Outsource cho bank)

Documenting workflows and results of business analysis and obtaining sign-off from users on specifications. Creating user story, acceptance criteria, the definition of ready and definition of done in the agile framework
Assisting the technical team in translating application functionality into application architecture and the production of a business functionality requirements statement.
Communicating the business directives, goals, and needs to the technical team and serving as business interface from the solution delivery team managing expectations and defining business satisfaction metrics.
Designing and executing test plans to ensure that business requirements and functional specifications are implemented properly and meet ROI objectives.
Participate in planning initiatives, feasibility studies, cost/benefit analysis, and new systems design.
Work with the QA team to prepare test scenarios and data. Document and manage business and functional requirements. Review user stories and acceptance criteria.
Provide thought leadership in one of the functional areas, handle queries and competency building in the respective functional areas. Provide functional solution and clarification on the inter-module dependencies.
Determine a project’s requirements by extracting them from business or government policies, as well as from current and future users, through interaction and research.
Anticipate future requirements to ensure successful outcomes. Constrain requirements when necessary and focus on core business needs, rather than users’ personal preferences, functions related to trends or outdated processes, or other non-essential modifications. Organize requirements into related categories to effectively manage and communicate them.
Use robust analysis and modeling tools to match strategic business objectives with practical technical solutions.
At regular intervals in the project life cycle, safeguard and protect the business and user’s needs by verifying functionality, accuracy and completeness of the requirements against the original documents. Safeguarding minimizes risk by ensuring requirements are being met before investing further in system development.
Emphasize simplicity and ease of use at all times, especially in implementation.
Identify and avoid extraneous activities that do not solve the problem or help reach the objective.
The business analyst is most knowledgeable about use cases; therefore, they continually verify the requirements and reject implementations that do not advance business objectives.
In application maintenance, the focus is on preventing and correcting defects; enhancements or making changes to increase the value provided by the system.

Our specialties have been nationally recognized for quality in areas such as cardiovascular care, oncology, orthopedics, geriatrics, obstetrics and gynecology, and gastroenterology.

Why join this team?

The Payer Relations team plays a critical role in advancing Scripps Health’s financial strategy and long-term growth. We are looking for a Data Analyst to support our vision to transform payer relationships from transactional to strategic by leveraging data and analytics to predict, model and secure optimal reimbursement terms while achieving sustainable net revenue growth and margin targets.

Responsibilities Include

Responsible for transforming complex payer data into actionable insights that drive smarter contract decisions.
Analyze complex data sets, proactively explore insights, and clearly communicate findings to both clinical and operational stakeholders.
Lead cross functional efforts across finance, strategy, and health system performance, to effectively negotiate, monitor, and optimize payer relationships.
Provide the analytical foundation for strategic growth, lead reimbursement modeling, trend analysis, financial proposal development, contract term optimization, risk assessment, and payer performance audits.
Direct business analysis for new and renewing payer contract negotiations, maintain payer contract portfolio reporting, and serve as a key partner to revenue cycle and other internal teams.

Required Education/Experience/Specialized Skills

Bachelor's degree in business, math or health administration.
3 years broad-base healthcare experience with knowledge of healthcare products and services knowledge.
Expert knowledge of Microsoft Excel, SQL and data manipulation.
Excellent communication skills and exceptional relationship-building skills.
Strong SQL and data manipulation skills, Detail-oriented with strong analytical abilities.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Strategic and critical thinking skills.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt

Master's degree in business, health administration, math or statistics preferred.
Knowledge and understanding of EPIC, Business Intelligence reporting technologies, and data mart technologies and principles.

The ERP Business Systems Analyst role is focused on developing a deep functional and technical understanding of key business systems and identifying the most effective ways to leverage them. Conduct meetings and workshops with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
Critically evaluate information from multiple sources, reconcile conflicting requirements, decompose high-level concepts into detailed requirements, and distinguish user requests from underlying business needs.
Analyze existing business processes and collaborate with stakeholders to refine, optimize, and develop new processes where required.
Develop deep functional and technical expertise in ERP systems (primarily Infor LN), related applications, and supporting business processes. Identify system gaps and recommend solutions to meet evolving business needs.
Create and maintain project documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, use cases, test cases, and other project artifacts throughout the project lifecycle.
Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and IT project teams, ensuring alignment of requirements, priorities, and deliverables.
Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, execute system validation, and support business users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Deliver training and knowledge transfer to end users and support teams on new processes, system enhancements, and project deliverables.
Provide post-implementation support, troubleshooting, and subject matter expertise to ensure successful adoption of implemented solutions.
Act as Tier 3 support for escalated issues involving Infor LN and other ERP applications, working closely with service desk and technical support teams to resolve complex issues.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams with minimal supervision.
Strong facilitation skills, including meeting planning and preparation, clear presentation of ideas, effective moderation of discussions, and the ability to drive alignment and consensus.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workloads, manage multiple tasks, and consistently meet deadlines.
Proven hands-on experience supporting and administering Infor LN.
Advanced troubleshooting, configuration, and application support skills with Infor LN.

Advanced business process knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Finance, Discrete Manufacturing, Engineer-to-Order (ETO) Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warehouse Management, and Service Management.
Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and business analysis best practices.
Experience working within Agile and project delivery methodologies.
Fluency in English is required.
Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical system solutions and recommendations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset.

Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related)
